items.title: TJX CEO: Distribution model will help weather El Niño
items.summary: The off-price retailer’s supply chain strategy allows it to hold inventory instead of going straight to stores, according to a Q2 earnings call.

items.title: Holiday Shopping Is Almost Here—And Target May Be Ready to Win Big
items.summary: Target cuts prices on over 10,000 items and plans October Deal Days ahead of Q3 earnings, with analysts, dividends, and institutional buying supporting shares near $142 support.

items.title: Discount retailer closes stores in several states
items.summary: The retailer has closed at least four stores in 2026 as it pursues new store formats and markets.

items.title: TJX Raises Fiscal 2027 Outlook as Q2 Results Show Broad-Based Growth
items.summary: TJX has raised its fiscal 2027 profit outlook after a Q2 beat, broad divisional gains and a higher store target, with Marmaxx execution a key test.

items.title: Should Investors Buy TJX as Growth Improves but Valuation Stays Rich?
items.summary: TJX pairs higher fiscal 2027 sales and earnings guidance with a bigger store target, but premium valuation and cost pressures raise the execution bar.

items.title: TJX Falls 17.4% in the Past Month as Strong Results Meet Key Risks
items.summary: TJX's shares sank 17.4% in a month as raised profit guidance and improving Marmaxx trends contend with wage, fuel and valuation pressures.

items.title: TJX International's Adjusted Margin Hits 7.3%: More Upside Ahead?
items.summary: TJX International's profitability improves alongside solid sales growth, supported by favorable merchandise margin and expense leverage.

items.title: Jim Cramer Questions TJX After Marmaxx Stumbles
items.summary: Jim Cramer raised concerns about The TJX Companies, Inc.
